text:
axel: Quick heads-up — Stonebrook dedicated cutover is scheduled TOMORROW 2024-11-05 02:00 UTC. Primary concern: kvcache backfill is expected to generate a short burst of write traffic. Need final ack on quiet-window and whether we hold the safety-pin.
priya: Can we shift the quiet window by +30m? There's a KMS rotation in ap-northeast that overlaps with 02:00–02:30 UTC right now.
marta: Prefer not to move customer-facing window; Stonebrook requested after-hours only. Is the KMS rotation mandatory or can we postpone?
priya: Rotation is optional this cycle — we can postpone if release team confirms.
axel: Okay — if ops can postpone KMS, we keep 02:00 start. Otherwise shift to 02:30. Which do we prefer?
ops-lia: We can postpone KMS by 48h, but need signoff from security. I've pinged @marta for the thumbs.
marta: I approve postponing KMS for 48h to keep Stonebrook window. :thumbsup:
deploybot: DeployBot: release job created: rlb-stonebrook-20241105-01
deploybot: Runbook -> https://internal/runbooks/stonebrook-cutover (checklist + rollback)
deploybot: Canary slice: tenant-slice-7, target traffic ramp: 10% -> 50% over 15m.
samir: Quick question about version pin — we're serving model v3.2.1-quant on the slice. Do we want to pin to exact commit or allow auto-compat fallback to v3.2.0?
axel: Pin to exact artifact tag: redwood-models/v3.2.1-quant@sha256:abcd1234. No auto-fallback for this rollout (we need deterministic perf).
priya: Acknowledged. I'll hard-pin in the rollout config. Also adding a throttle on backfill to keep write QPS under 300.
axel: Good. Rollback criteria:  p95 latency > 1200ms OR error rate spike > 0.8% sustained for 5m -> immediate rollback to v3.2.0.
marta: Add customer-facing note in release notes: out-of-hours maintenance window, brief latency blip possible during cache priming. I'll draft and post to CS.
axel: Draft release note: "Planned performance tuning and cache priming for Stonebrook dedicated slice. Short latency increase possible during priming; no query loss expected." ok?
marta: ok.
priya: Ops checklist snippet: ```bash
# drain command
./deployctl drain --tenant stonebrook --timeout 300s
# start backfill
./backfillctl start --tenant stonebrook --rate 250qps
```
ops-lia: Will run drain + backfill after canary green, and keep extra observers on metrics (cpu/gpu, write qps, KVCACHE hit rate).
samir: Also note: KV cache surge could fill GPU memory with KV pages for long sequences. Add a soft cap: kv_cache_max_pages=12000 in runtime config.
axel: Ack. Please push the config to the release branch and link the PR.
priya: PR -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/release/stonebrook-kvcache-config/pull/42 (contains pin + throttle + kv cap).
marta: Security postponed KMS rotation — confirmed via DM. We're green. :white_check_mark:
axel: Last call for safety-pin? If no objections, we'll request final approval at 01:15 UTC tomorrow and kick deploybot for canary at 02:00.
priya: Approve. I will monitor metrics dashboard and have rollback command ready. :eyes:
samir: Approve from infra side.
ops-lia: Approve, ops on standby.
axel: Great — final approval collected. Will post release notes and notify CS.
deploybot: DeployBot: scheduled job rlb-stonebrook-20241105-01 at 2024-11-05T02:00:00Z. Canary -> slice-7. Notifications will appear in this channel.
marta: Thanks team, I'll send the external note and set CS on call.
priya: After deploy, watch these dashboards: /dashboards/stonebrook/latency, /dashboards/stonebrook/kvcache-metrics. If anything degrades, run: `./deployctl rollback --tag v3.2.0 --tenant stonebrook`
axel: Closing thread — will post a short postmortem if we hit rollback. Good luck. :rocket:
